verdict.rationale: Modal publishes its client SDK source (Python, JS and Go SDKs plus the CLI) in a public GitHub repo, modal-labs/modal-client, so part of the product's source is readable. The evidence does not state any license, and the core serverless platform/backend source is not shown to be available. missing for 10: evidence of an open-source license (e.g., Apache/MIT) on the repo, availability of the platform/server-side source beyond the client SDK, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
The JS and Go SDKs allow you to use Modal Sandboxes, invoke deployed Modal Functions, and interact with some Modal platform resources.
